title: API Rate Limiting and Quota Guidelines
description: Technical documentation explaining request rate limits, burst thresholds, and HTTP 429 status response handling.

segments.title: Default Tier Rate Limits
segments.summary: Standard tier API keys are capped at 60 requests per minute and 10,000 requests per calendar day.
segments.transcript: All developer accounts are provisioned with standard tier quotas upon creation. You may transmit up to 60 HTTP requests every 60 seconds. Daily usage is capped at 10,000 calls...
possible_questions: What is the request rate limit for standard API keys?
How many requests per day am I allowed to send?

segments.title: Handling HTTP 429 and Retry-After Headers
segments.summary: Explains exponential backoff and inspecting the Retry-After response header when receiving HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.
segments.transcript: When your application exceeds configured rate limits, our gateway responds with HTTP status 429 (Too Many Requests). The response header contains Retry-After specifying wait time...
possible_questions: What should my app do if it gets an HTTP 429 error?
How long do I need to wait after being rate limited?
